notes.title: Play The Demo Prototype!
notes.content:
Reporting in,

Kill Spree demo prototype is now available. Try it out and let us know what you think!

[b]Changelog[/b]: 

[list]
[*] New accolades
[*] New Easter eggs/secrets
[*] Improved movement
[*] Improved performance and lighting on both maps
[*] Improved animation while bunny-hopping
[*] Improved sound design
[*] Improved main menu 
[*] Extended freerunning obstacle course on Experimental map
[*] Fixed raining in cave
[*] Fixed sniper moving while scoped
[*] Fixed crosshair turning red on dead bots
[/list]
[b]How you can support us:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Play the demo prototype.
[*] Give us your feedback.
[*] Wishlist and follow us on Steam. It's free and makes a big difference. Every wishlist helps visibility.
[*] Tell your friends, favorite content creators, and the media about Kill Spree.
[/olist]

Over,
Wunzero

notes.title: Super Important Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Listen up, soldiers.[/b]

Kill Spree is a next-level passion project, created because our favorite first-person shooter (FPS) game was heavily neglected by unwise companies. There's no game like Kill Spree when it comes to movement mechanics and kill satisfaction. The planned social and interactive user-interface idea is also a game changer, and has never been done before in any FPS game.

The only thing we asked from the community, since the foundation of Kill Spree, was to take part in surveys and help us get known by spreading the word. [b]Your help is needed the most now.[/b] We need an investment to continue steady development of Kill Spree, and investors only fund high potential projects. Let's work as a team to ensure Kill Spree demo is super successful for the Steam release. We need to create shock and awe. To best achieve this, [b]we must:[/b]

[list]
[*] wishlist on Steam and tell others to do the same
[*] tell a friend to tell a friend
[*] tell your family members
[*] play when the demo releases on Steam
[*] support us on our social media accounts
[*] create videos and livestreams
[*] give us constructive criticism on our Discord chat
[*] don't allow the few haters to manipulate your thoughts about us and the game; think independently
[/list]
Kill Spree isn't for everyone. We serve people who:

[list]
[*] love to move freely in-game
[*] love great soundtracks
[*] want to feel like a badass when killing opponents
[*] chills when not playing seriously; to feel cozy
[*] played old-school Korean FPS games
[/list]
Please keep in mind that Kill Spree is in Early Access phase. The upcoming Steam demo will have bug fixes, performance improvements, gameplay changes and some new content. Future versions of Kill Spree will only be available on Steam. This is the game we were missing. Help us, help you. [b]Stay positive and God bless.[/b]

With gratitude,
Wunzero
